app.title: MediKiosk

landing.hero_title: From Patient Story to Physician-Ready History
landing.hero_subtitle: Self-service clinical intake kiosk that digitizes patient history, scans medical records, detects potential red flags, and prepares a structured clinical summary before doctor consultation.
landing.step1_desc: Scan ABHA ID or enter basic demographics seamlessly.
landing.step2_desc: Natural multilingual AI dialogue via voice or touch chips.
landing.step3_desc: Digitize old prescriptions & lab reports with structured OCR.
landing.step4_desc: AI generates physician-ready draft with 30s quick view.
landing.step5_desc: Doctor verifies and syncs with Hospital Information System.

language.title: Choose Your Preferred Language
language.subtitle: आपकी भाषा • तुमची भाषा • Your Language
language.select_prompt: Select the language you feel most comfortable speaking and reading:

consent.title: Your Health Information Matters
consent.subtitle: Transparent, secure, and clinical-grade intake consent
consent.point1_desc: To understand your health complaints and prepare an accurate clinical history for your attending physician.
consent.point2_desc: Our AI helps guide questions and structure your story into a draft. The physician remains the final decision maker.
consent.point3_desc: Your health records remain encrypted and conform to Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) standards.
consent.point4_desc: High-risk symptoms are automatically flagged to alert emergency medical staff immediately.
consent.policy_note: Consent can be withdrawn according to hospital policy at any time.

identity.ayush_mode_desc: Includes Prakriti, Agni, and Ayurvedic lifestyle history
